changelog: • Auto Notification Card: Automatically displays upcoming doctor visits based on user city preferences and the existing schedule.
• Special Day Mode: Uses existing Special Day Mode configuration when determining upcoming visits.
• Cancellation Alerts: Shows cancelled visit announcements and the next valid visit in the same card.
• City-Specific Details: Adds Marathi city names, fixed visiting hours, and clickable contact numbers for all eight cities.
• Smart Refresh: Recalculates notifications on app opening and refreshes shared configuration periodically, including for non-logged-in users.
• Improved Scheduling: Prioritizes the earliest visit time when multiple cities have visits on the same date and waits for valid configuration before displaying a card.
• Backend Unchanged: No changes to code.gs or backend endpoints.
